title: 盖红章的通知信  (The Red-Stamped Letter)

segments.t: After letting Peng into the courtyard so the brothers have privacy, Qing slips back inside to the front desk, where Mei watches warmly and Manager Zhou opens the registered envelope. Listen first.
小晴，隔着玻璃看——他们俩在树下面对面站着呢！
谁也没走开！志豪正指着那两把椅子呢！
太好了……趁着等他们，我扫一眼这封房东来信。
多半是粉刷街边木窗那种无聊通知吧。
啊……不好。我的椅子在哪儿？我腿发软。
周经理！您脸色全白了！快坐下——信上写了什么？
小晴，替我念第一行。快说是我眼镜又看花眼了！
产权转让通知：八号小院整栋建筑将作为商业办公楼出售。
商业办公楼出售？！把我们的客栈和厨房变成灰色办公室？！
新买家来看房子之前，只给我们三十天时间！
等等——通知背面回形针还别着第二页折起来的纸……
先别对外面透露一个字！让两兄弟先过完这个星期五下午！
Now let's walk through the scene, one line at a time.
小晴，隔着玻璃看——他们俩在树下面对面站着呢！
'Qing, look through the glass—the two of them are standing face to face under the tree!' Transparent four-beat phrase
面对面
puts 'face toward face' together just like English 'face to face'.
谁也没走开！志豪正指着那两把椅子呢！
'Neither of them walked away! Hao is pointing at those two chairs right now!' Pairing 'who' with 'also did not walk away' gives Mandarin's clean way to say 'neither one walked away'.
太好了……趁着等他们，我扫一眼这封房东来信。
'Wonderful... while we wait, let me glance at this letter from the landlord.' Natural reading expression
扫一眼
literally 'sweep one glance', means 'skim quickly'.
多半是粉刷街边木窗那种无聊通知吧。
'Probably some boring notice about painting the street shutters.' Handy everyday guess word:
多半
literally 'more than half', means 'most likely' or 'probably'.
周经理！您脸色全白了！快坐下——信上写了什么？
'Manager Zhou! Your face went completely white! Sit down quickly—what does the letter say?' Compound
脸色
joins 'face' with 'colour' to describe someone's complexion turning pale.
产权转让通知：八号小院整栋建筑将作为商业办公楼出售。
'Property Transfer Notice: Courtyard Building Eight offered for sale as commercial offices.' Formal notice word
出售
means 'offer for sale', more official than everyday 'sell'.
商业办公楼出售？！把我们的客栈和厨房变成灰色办公室？！
'Commercial office sale?! Turn our inn and kitchen into grey offices?!' Adding 'into' onto 'change' creates
变成
showing one thing turning into something else completely.
先别对外面透露一个字！让两兄弟先过完这个星期五下午！

'Not a single word to anyone outside yet! Let the two brothers have their Friday afternoon first!' Saying 'not reveal one single character' works exactly like English 'not breathe a single word'. Now let's hear the whole conversation again from start to finish.
小晴，隔着玻璃看——他们俩在树下面对面站着呢！
谁也没走开！志豪正指着那两把椅子呢！
太好了……趁着等他们，我扫一眼这封房东来信。
多半是粉刷街边木窗那种无聊通知吧。
啊……不好。我的椅子在哪儿？我腿发软。
周经理！您脸色全白了！快坐下——信上写了什么？
小晴，替我念第一行。快说是我眼镜又看花眼了！

商业办公楼出售？！把我们的客栈和厨房变成灰色办公室？！
新买家来看房子之前，只给我们三十天时间！
等等——通知背面回形针还别着第二页折起来的纸……
先别对外面透露一个字！让两兄弟先过完这个星期五下午！

Outside beneath the shade tree two estranged brothers finally sit down together, while inside at the desk a thirty-day commercial sale notice threatens Courtyard Inn. Episode 5 is done; join us for the Season 1 finale in Episode 6.
下次见！
